note: Paragraphs jQuery UI Accordion provides one field formatter, paragraphs_jquery_ui_accordion_formatter, for multi-value entity_reference_revisions fields targeting the paragraph entity type. Settings: bundle, title, content, view_mode, active, simple_id, autoscroll, autoscroll_offset, autoscroll_offset_toolbar (schema field.formatter.settings.paragraphs_jquery_ui_accordion_formatter). No settings page, no permissions. It uses core's bundled jQuery UI accordion via jquery_ui_accordion (no extra libs). Medium/hard cases are grounded in a real entity view display: introspection reads the formatter type and its 'bundle' setting; execution switches a paragraph field's formatter to the accordion formatter and flips 'active' to open the first panel, verified against the live entity_view_display. Fields are namespaced field_pjqa_*.

evals.prompt: In Drupal, how do I display a multi-value Paragraphs field as a jQuery UI accordion using the paragraphs_jquery_ui_accordion module? What field type does it apply to and where do I enable it?
evals.expected_output: On the entity's Manage display, choose the 'Paragraphs jQuery UI Accordion' formatter (paragraphs_jquery_ui_accordion_formatter) for a multi-value entity_reference_revisions field that targets paragraphs.

evals.prompt: Which formatter settings of paragraphs_jquery_ui_accordion decide which paragraph bundle is used and which fields become the accordion header vs the collapsible body?
evals.expected_output: The 'bundle' setting selects the paragraph bundle; 'title' selects the field used as the accordion header; 'content' selects the field rendered as the collapsible body (with 'view_mode' controlling how the body is rendered).

evals.prompt: Does paragraphs_jquery_ui_accordion require downloading an external jQuery UI library, or does it rely on something already in Drupal?
evals.expected_output: No external download is needed — it attaches its own 'accordion' library which depends on Drupal core's bundled jQuery UI Accordion via the jquery_ui_accordion module.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, one paragraph field on the Article content type's default display is rendered as a jQuery UI accordion. Inspect the live view display and give the machine name of that field.
evals.expected_output: field_pjqa_ref — in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default its component type is paragraphs_jquery_ui_accordion_formatter.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article field field_pjqa_faq is displayed with the Paragraphs jQuery UI Accordion formatter. Which paragraph bundle is that formatter configured to read? Inspect the live view display.
evals.expected_output: pjqa_faq_item — the accordion formatter's 'bundle' setting on field_pjqa_faq in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default is pjqa_faq_item.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a multi-value paragraph reference field field_pjqa_task currently shown with the default paragraph formatter. Change its default view display so the field is rendered as a jQuery UI accordion using the paragraphs_jquery_ui_accordion module. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_pjqa_task component type is set to paragraphs_jquery_ui_accordion_formatter (e.g. via the entity_display.repository view display setComponent + save).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article field field_pjqa_open is already rendered as a Paragraphs jQuery UI Accordion, but all panels start collapsed. Configure the formatter so the first accordion panel is open by default. Apply the change to the live view display.
evals.expected_output: The accordion formatter's 'active' setting on field_pjqa_open is set to 1 in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default (open first panel by default).
